title: Marketplace provisioning: IAM + webhook config for entitlement sync (least privilege)
author: Ethan Park
description: Context: Marketplace-driven customers need a reliable subscription → entitlement → org provisioning flow. The control-plane entitlement sync service now consumes entitlement signals from both AWS Marketplace (API polling + optional notifications) and GCP Marketplace (vendor webhook). This PR adds Terraform-managed IAM, network, and webhook plumbing needed by the entitlement sync services while keeping permissions least-privilege and auditable. Changes: (1) AWS IAM: new dedicated IAM role for entitlement-sync with scoped permissions to aws-marketplace entitlement + metering APIs; separate role for webhook verifier to read secrets and write limited logs/metrics; explicit deny for broad S3 and KMS actions; (2) Webhook ingress: add an internal ALB listener rule + path-based routing for /marketplace/gcp/webhook to the entitlement-sync service target group; add WAF rule set and request size limits; (3) Secrets and key usage: provision an SSM parameter + Secrets Manager secret for GCP webhook signing key rotation, and KMS grants scoped to decrypt only those secrets; (4) Observability + safety: cloudwatch alarms for 5xx spikes on the webhook path, and metric filters for signature verification failures; (5) Documentation: inline least-privilege notes and a short README section on how to validate in staging. Notes: This does not change application logic—only infra wiring and policy boundaries. Follow-up: once we confirm partner testing, we can enable optional SNS-based AWS notifications in prod (module is included but off by default).
commits_summary: 1) terraform: add entitlement-sync IAM role + scoped marketplace permissions 2) terraform: add secrets manager + kms grants for webhook signing key 3) terraform: add ALB routing and WAF rules for /marketplace/gcp/webhook 4) terraform: add cloudwatch alarms/metric filters for webhook failures 5) docs: update ops README for staging validation steps
changed_areas: Infrastructure modules updated: marketplace-entitlement-sync, iam-roles, alb-routing, waf, secrets, monitoring. Notable files: modules/marketplace-entitlement-sync/iam.tf; modules/marketplace-entitlement-sync/alb.tf; modules/security/waf_marketplace.tf; modules/observability/alarms_marketplace.tf; environments/staging/marketplace.tf; environments/prod/marketplace.tf; docs/marketplace-entitlement-sync.md.
notable_snippets: IAM policy excerpt (entitlement-sync role): Allow marketplace entitlement reads: "action": ["aws-marketplace:ResolveCustomer", "aws-marketplace:GetEntitlements"], "resource": "*" (AWS Marketplace APIs do not support resource-level scoping). Allow metering only for our product codes via condition: "aws-marketplace:BatchMeterUsage" with Condition StringEquals "aws:PrincipalTag/Product": "marketplace". Secrets decrypt constrained: kms:Decrypt only when encryption context matches SecretsManager ARNs used by the webhook key. ALB route: path-pattern "/marketplace/gcp/webhook" → target group entitlement-sync; WAF: allowlist Redwood partner IP ranges in staging, signature verification failures rate-limited, body size capped at 64KB.
test_plan: Terraform plan/apply in staging workspace; verify: (1) entitlement-sync task role assumes correctly and can call AWS Marketplace GetEntitlements in staging; (2) GCP webhook hits /marketplace/gcp/webhook returns 200 on valid signature, 401 on invalid signature; (3) alarms created and in OK state; (4) WAF blocks oversized payloads; (5) secrets rotation does not require a redeploy (read on request).
rollout_plan: Staging apply immediately after merge; run partner webhook replay tests; enable prod ALB listener rule and WAF in guarded mode (count) for 24h; then switch WAF rules to block; keep optional AWS SNS notifications disabled in prod until partner validation completes.
security_considerations: Least-privilege: separate roles for sync vs webhook verification; no wildcard admin permissions; KMS decrypt limited to specific secrets; no write access to customer data stores granted here. Webhook hardening: WAF + rate limiting + request size cap; signature key stored in Secrets Manager; logs include request IDs only (no payload logging).
review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security): AWS Marketplace permissions are necessarily resource="*"; can we add a guardrail to prevent accidental broadening to unrelated AWS APIs? Author: added explicit deny for s3:* and kms:* outside the specific secrets and added a policy lint note in module README.

Cole Summers (Billing/Metering): metering calls should be scoped to product code conditions—do we tag the role or use condition keys? Author: added PrincipalTag Product=marketplace and updated task role tags in ECS module; added note that metering is condition-scoped and validated via IAM policy simulator.

Naomi Feldman (Compliance): please ensure we don’t log webhook payloads in ALB access logs / app logs by default. Author: confirmed ALB access logs only include request metadata; no app payload logging configured in infra; added log redaction note to docs.

Priya Natarajan (Platform): staging-only partner IP allowlist is good; ensure prod doesn’t accidentally inherit. Author: moved allowlist to env var toggle; prod defaults to off; terraform validation added to prevent enabling in prod without explicit override.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash; applied to staging within 2 hours post-merge (runbook: ops/marketplace-entitlement-sync.md).
release_notes: Marketplace entitlement sync infra now has dedicated least-privilege IAM roles and hardened webhook ingress for GCP entitlement events; adds alarms for webhook error rates and signature failures.
